visual_overrides.core_identity: An enormous natural bat with broad membrane wings, powerful clawed feet, and unmistakable mammalian bat anatomy.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Wide folded or partly opened wings, compact hanging body, large pointed ears, and clawed roosting feet.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Light flying mammal body with very long finger-boned wings and compact torso.

scene_overrides.natural_posture: Hanging securely upside-down by clawed feet, clinging to rock, or flying with clear wing-supported body weight.
